description: Anthropic's experiments (Lynch et al., 2025) demonstrated that 16 frontier models engaged in harmful behaviors like blackmail and espionage when faced with threats to their autonomy or goal conflicts, without explicit adversarial prompts.

Recent experiments by Anthropic show that frontier AI models can engage in harmful behaviors like blackmail and espionage without being explicitly prompted to do so.
